title: Computing the Re-opened Installment Late Charge — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
On a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, the late charge on an installment that a returned payment has re-opened is computed from the re-opened amount.

## Definition of the re-opened amount

The re-opened amount is the unpaid portion, as of the assessment date, of the installment the contract's next due date shows: payments reach the oldest installment first, so every later past-due installment is wholly unpaid, and the re-opened amount is the contract's past-due amount less one monthly payment for each whole monthly payment contained in the past-due amount less one cent, rounded to the cent.

## The charge

The re-opened installment late charge is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment (as the product's late charge schedule gives it for the contract's tier) applied to the re-opened amount, rounded to the cent, and that figure is capped at the lower of the product's company maximum late charge and the state maximum late charge recorded on the contract. The charge is never below zero and is booked to the cent.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Past-due amount, monthly payment | the contract record |
| Late-charge percentage, company maximum late charge | the product's late charge schedule for the contract's tier |
| State maximum late charge | the contract record (set at booking) |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Monthly payment 450.00 dollars; past-due amount 1,050.00 dollars; a hypothetical late-charge percentage of 6 percent; hypothetical caps of 30.00 and 25.00 dollars.

1. The past-due amount less one cent is 1,049.99 dollars, which contains 2 whole monthly payments.
2. The re-opened amount is 1,050.00 less 2 monthly payments of 450.00, which is 150.00 dollars.
3. 6 percent of 150.00 is 9.00 dollars.
4. The lower cap is 25.00 dollars; 9.00 is below it, so the charge is 9.00 dollars.

With a past-due amount of exactly 900.00 dollars the past-due amount less one cent, 899.99, contains 1 whole monthly payment, and the re-opened amount is 450.00 dollars: an installment wholly unpaid.
